correctStatements.text: At 06:15 Gunnar reported that partners were seeing handshake failures against the gateway hostname.
At 06:19 Leila confirmed that the leaf certificate had expired at 06:00 UTC that day.
Hiro found the renewal job had silently failed three weeks earlier when the DNS challenge hook was removed.
Esperanza said four partner integrations were fully down, accounting for about 15 percent of order volume.
At 06:30 Hiro began issuing a new certificate manually using the HTTP challenge.
At 06:41 Hiro obtained the new certificate and started installing it on the load balancers.
At 06:47 Leila verified that handshakes succeeded from three external vantage points.
At 06:55 Gunnar saw partner traffic flowing again with volume back to the usual level.
At 07:10 Esperanza sent the all-clear note to the four affected partners.
Hiro will restore the DNS challenge hook and test renewal in staging.
Leila will add an alert for certificates with fewer than 21 days remaining.
Gunnar summarised that a silently failing renewal job let the partner gateway certificate lapse, causing about 55 minutes of partner downtime.
